description: Create the Base64 TLV text for a ZATCA Phase 1 simplified e-invoice QR code (seller, VAT number, timestamp, total, VAT), or decode the text read from any ZATCA invoice QR. Web version: https://irfanaslam.io/tools/zatca-qr-code

base64.description: decode: the Base64 text from the QR code

vat_number.description: create: 15-digit VAT number starting and ending with 3

vat_total.description: create: VAT amount (SAR); default 15/115 of the total

name: zatca_qr_code
title: ZATCA e-invoice QR (TLV)
